notes.claim: Factorising is the reverse process to expanding brackets.
The greatest common factor of terms is the largest factor that divides evenly into all of them, and it is the one taken out of the bracket.

sources.title: 1.5 Factoring Polynomials - College Algebra 2e | OpenStax
sources.quote: The greatest common factor (GCF) of polynomials is the largest polynomial that divides evenly into the polynomials.

sources.title: Core concept 1.4: Simplifying and manipulating expressions, equations and formulae
